# HAPI v0.27.3.3

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Adds the mobile suspend/resume SSE recovery fix: a 45s visibility-resume stale threshold (down from 90s), a 10s connect-open deadline that abandons connections hung on dead pooled sockets, and an immediate first reconnect attempt — so the "Reconnecting... (stream error)" banner no longer persists after returning from a backgrounded mobile tab (fork PR #5; reimplements the reconnect half of upstream PR #989, which was closed unmerged).
- Localizes the new `connect-timeout` and `transport-error` reconnecting-banner reasons.
- Picks up upstream `fix(web): improve session search UI (#1545)` (new search placeholder / open-action copy, expanded search fields).
- Upstream now officially includes #1529 (exclusive Cursor list-model / ACP spawn lease), previously carried ahead of merge; the official version supersedes the carried patch.
- Per the 2026-08-13 operator ruling, PR #1091 (managed agent API profiles) is recorded as `drop` in this release ledger until its session model-picker grouping is fixed.

## Compared with the official release

- Same maintained overlay as `v0.27.3.2`, based on official HAPI `v0.27.3`, plus the SSE mobile-recovery fix above and the two newer upstream commits (#1545 session search UI, official #1529).
- Uses four-part version `0.27.3.3`; platform optional dependencies remain pinned to official `0.27.3`.
